# S4.8 — Multi-agent coordination & consistency (C3): `scoped_subtree`/`share` environments with `resource(key)` leases + HLC, K-1 declaration checks, `check_write` ownership verdicts + transfer/return, `three_way_text{line}` and `validator_selected` merge arms with deterministic `merge_hash` and absent-child accounting, peer-message `artefact.{delivered,activated,followed}` rows, the `judged` loop detector (`JudgePort`, cadence, `stop→deny` clamp), `model_fallback` (`model.rerouted` + `profile_override`), hosted boundary cancel + `budget_exhausted{dimension: unknown}`, `loop_*`/`format_failure_rate` typed `n/a`, the K-4 `coordination_delta` classifier and `lab/coordination-topology-v1`

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §05e.5 (`R-2.6.5`) + §05e.2 (`R-2.6.2¹`)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/070_S4.8__coordination.md` (sequence 70 of 106)
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.6.5, R-2.6.2¹**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.7` (stacked @ `25823ed`) ·
**Stage:** 4 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only — every verification is hermetic/in-process
(in-memory ledger stores, test derivers/validators, no model calls, no
external egress)
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0300-s4.8-coordination-consistency-rulings.md`
**Deferrals:** `DF-S2.3-1`, `DF-S1.20-1`, `DF-S1.18-1` progress noted;
none opened, none closed

## Summary

This lands the C3 coordination layer on top of the S4.6 spawn kernel:
two new environment modes with cross-run `resource(key)` mutual
exclusion, the merge-policy arms that make a multi-writer workspace
safe, the ownership verbs, the messaging audit trail, the judged
detector arm of the loop ladder, the `model_fallback` retry delta, and
the hosted boundary's honest lifts — all durable-fact-first, so every
behaviour re-folds identically after a crash.

**Environments & locks (`hh-env`, `hh-ledger`, `hh-subagent::spawn`).**
`DeriveMode::Share` now provisions the child with the parent's roots
verbatim — one shared mutable view; `scoped_subtree` keeps its narrowed
roots; write coordination is the ownership/`resource(key)` layer above
the fs, never a copied view. `share`/`scoped_subtree` spawns acquire
every `reserved_keys[]` `resource:<key>` scoped lease all-or-nothing in
canonical sorted order (`holder = subagent:{child_run_id}`) before the
child runs; a *cross-run* live-holder scan (`Store::scoped_lease_holders`)
makes a sibling `share` writer's lock contend, a same-child record is
adopted on spawn retry, a failed acquisition releases the prefix and
refuses `ResourceLockTimeout` — a refused spawn holds no key. `share`
activates `Store::require_hlc` on the parent (K-2 — the coordination
record must causally order against shared children). `on_parent_end =
detach_to_child` under either shared mode is refused `ModeUnsupported`
at spawn (O-2), before any reservation.

**Consistency & policy (`hh-subagent::consistency`, `hh-hir`).** The
closed `ConsistencyLevel` six + `ConsistencyDeclaration` +
`CoordinationPolicy` codecs; K-1 refuses the three named
inconsistencies (`share` ⇏ `snapshot_at_fork`; `fork_snapshot` ⇏
`per_key_serializable`; `scoped_subtree` ⇏ `snapshot_at_fork`) and any
malformed declaration, before side effects. K-4's `coordination_dir`
classifies loosening over the whole policy surface — level drops on the
strength lattice, `sibling`/`broadcast` enabling, cap raises,
`default_isolation` widening, `on_absent_child = annotate`, merge-policy
rank drops — with `causal_cross_run`/`strong_eventual_union` ranked
equal so an incomparable swap is `none`, never a guessed direction.

**Ownership (`hh-subagent::ownership`, `hh-ledger`).** `check_write`
returns `Ok`/`NotOwner`/`Fenced` (containment-covering, lease-backed for
`ResourceKey` objects); denials append `security.policy.evaluated`
audit rows. `transfer_ownership`/`return_ownership` land durable
`control.ownership.transferred`/`returned` rows; the spawn's conferral
writes `control.ownership.granted`. The projection folds roots plus all
three verbs across every run in the store — a sibling relay sees the
same table. `release_resource_locks` frees the child's `resource:*`
holds at result/cancel/unresponsive terminal.

**Merge (`hh-subagent::merge`).** `MergePolicy::ThreeWayText` runs a
diff3 line engine over baseline/parent/child: identical and one-sided
edits merge, disjoint hunks merge both sides, overlapping hunks become
`MergeConflictRecord{detector: three_way_text{line}}` — never a silent
pick; merged content is a content-addressed blob.
`MergePolicy::ValidatorSelected` drives the `MergeValidator` port
(`choose_parent`/`choose_child`/`supersede`/`coexist`/`abandon`/
`abstain`); abstention leaves the conflict open, an unbound port vetoes
`ValidatorUnavailable`, and resolutions land as `control.merge.
{proposed,resolved}` rows naming the `validator_ref`. Every input lands
in exactly one of `merged[]`/`conflicts[]`/`absent[]`; a hole vetoes
`LostWrite{count}`. `merge_hash` is content-addressed over the canonical
report projection — identical whichever child finished first and after
a crash re-fold. `on_absent_child = block_completion` keeps absent
children out of `merged[]` and blocks the completion gate; `annotate`
records without blocking.

**Messaging (`hh-subagent::messaging`).** Delivery fires the receiver's
`peer_message{from}` occurrence once per `message_id` (W-1 idempotence)
and lands `context.artefact.delivered{kind: peer_message}`; the
`activated`/`followed` emitters and the `message_followed_rate`
projection make T-LCD-13's per-profile metric computable. Messages carry
`body_ref` + ctx label — refs and labels, never authority (CC2).

**Judged detector & model_fallback (`hh-control`).** `JudgePort` +
`detect_with_judge` run the `LoopPolicy.judged{validator_ref,
interval_turns, confidence_threshold_ppm, charged_to}` declaration on
the same `[nudge→deny→stop]` ladder as the four deterministic detectors:
cadence-bounded (no re-fire inside the interval), `validator_ref` +
confidence stamped on the `control.loop.detected` row, `stop` clamped to
`deny` (ADR-0108 — a judged hit is never sole grounds for a stop), and
`judge: None`/below-threshold emits nothing. `DeltaKind::ModelFallback
{profile_ref}` is admitted only when `attempt_delta_allowed` declares
it; on the retry's dispatch the driver appends `model.rerouted{
model_call_id, to_profile_ref, cause: model_fallback, basis,
charged_to}` and stamps `profile_override` on the re-assembled request —
scope and attempt arithmetic unchanged, never a silent alteration.

**Hosted boundary (`hh-hosting`, `hh-telemetry`).** Boundary-budget
exhaustion now cancels the participant through the ABI's own
`session/cancel` verb (`cancel_via`/`cancel_ok` honestly on the
exhaustion row — drift evidence, never a synthetic drop) and lifts to
`budget_exhausted{dimension: "unknown"}` when the participant's word
names no kernel `DimensionId` (the raw spelling survives on
`stop_reason_raw`/`dimension`). `loop_stop_rate`,
`loop_nudge_recovery_rate` and `format_failure_rate` are declared
metrics over `control.loop.detected`/`control.output.rejected`/
`model.call.requested`; hosted runs without observable calls render
`n/a{estimator_undefined}` — never a fabricated zero.

**Lab (`hh-orchestrator`).** `lab/coordination-topology-v1` binds the
closed four-member `topology` factor (`single_agent`/
`orchestrator_worker_isolated`/`orchestrator_worker_share`/
`peer_messaging`) × `merge_policy` × `default_isolation` under
`MatchSpec{matched_total}`: child usage folds `charged_to = subject`,
`lost_write_count`/`conflicts_open_at_completion`/`absent_children`
fold from durable merge rows, and `coordination_match_report` re-runs
the shared matched gate — a missing `MatchSpec` or unaccounted dim
refuses — stamping the `coordination_topology_v1_arm_report` kind every
"multi-agent helps" `ComparisonReport` cites.

## Deferrals

`DF-S2.3-1` (`child_terminal` + `peer_message` subscription producers
landed), `DF-S1.20-1` (`woken{peer_message}` occurrences produced), and
`DF-S1.18-1` (`model.rerouted` emitter call site landed) each received
dated progress notes; their residuals stay OPEN to the named owners.
None opened, none closed. D-6 (cross-item shared-state) remains
deferred per ADR-0211 — ownership is per coordination object within one
activation.

## Deviation / decision records

`docs/adr/ADR-0300` — `resource(key)` rides the scoped-lease fold +
cross-run holder scan (no second lease mechanism); `share` derives
verbatim roots with coordination above the fs; `require_hlc` under
`share`; detach refused at spawn (O-2); `check_write` three-way verdict
with audited denials; three-way line merge never picks on overlap;
`MergeValidator` port required for `validator_selected` (abstain stays
open, no port ⇒ typed veto); `merge_hash` over the canonical
{merged,conflicts,absent} projection; equal-strength consistency levels
classify `none` under K-4; the judged detector is cadence-bound and
`stop`-clamped; `model_fallback` executes via `model.rerouted` +
`profile_override` on the recorded basis; hosted exhaustion cancels via
the ABI verb and lifts `dimension: unknown` honestly; the topology arm
binds the closed factor and folds every arm fact from durable rows.
